title: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.11387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symbolic regression combines structural search with numerical fitting, but aggregate fit scores do not describe how the remaining error varies across inputs. We introduce RISR, a residual-informed method that uses these error patterns to guide formula discovery and learn which corrections are worth fitting. A residual encoder compresses aligned inputs, targets, current predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model to propose formulas. For subsequent refinement, a dual-view relational encoder uses additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. We evaluate RISR on scientific tasks from the LLM-SRBench. RISR achieves 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at the 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, respectively. translated_title: RISR：基于残差信息的大语言模型科学方程发现
translated_abstract: 符号回归将结构搜索与数值拟合相结合，但总体拟合分数并不能描述剩余误差在不同输入上的变化情况。我们提出了RISR，一种残差信息驱动的方法，它利用这些误差模式来指导公式发现，并学习哪些修正值得拟合。残差编码器将对齐的输入、目标值、当前预测和残差压缩为连续的token，用于调节语言模型以提出公式。在后续的细化过程中，双视图关系编码器使用加性残差和正则化乘性残差来预测候选修正在拟合后的效用。我们在LLM-SRBench的科学任务上对RISR进行了评估。RISR在1%和0.1%的逐点相对误差容限下分别达到了63.57%和38.50%的分布内（ID）准确率，相应的分布外（OOD）准确率分别为56.07%和38.24%。在使用相同骨干网络的情况下，RISR优于已报告的基线方法。
tldr: RISR通过利用残差误差模式引导大语言模型进行科学方程发现，在LLM-SRBench上以相同骨干网络超越了现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: RISR leverages residual error patterns to guide large language models in scientific equation discovery, outperforming baselines with the same backbone on LLM-SRBench.
